hero.title: The compact sachet-based PDA solution for structuring your dose preparation service
paragraphs: The RDC 45 enables pharmacies in Morocco to professionalize dose preparation with a compact, scalable, semi-automated solution.

Designed for sachet-based PDA, it supports pharmacies wishing to provide a clearer, better-organized, and safer service for patients taking multiple medicines, living with chronic conditions, or receiving long-term treatment.
With the RDC 45, a pharmacy can move from a difficult manual preparation process to one that is guided, structured, and easier to promote to patients, families, and healthcare partners.

paragraphs: Dual Blist is a semi-automated PDA solution designed to help pharmacies provide a more structured, traceable, and efficient dose preparation service.

With an aging population, chronic treatments, and polypharmacy, PDA offers Moroccan pharmacies an opportunity to stand out: strengthening pharmaceutical follow-up, building patient loyalty, and providing a valuable service to families, caregivers, and partner organizations.
With Dual Blist, the pharmacy does more than prepare doses. It builds a high-value pharmacy service founded on organization, traceability, and preparation quality.

opportunity.subtitle: A new pharmacy service to create, structure, and promote
paragraphs: PDA is still relatively underdeveloped in Morocco. That is precisely what makes it an opportunity for pharmacies wishing to move ahead of the market.

Older patients and people with chronic conditions or multiple medications need clearer support in managing their treatment. Families are looking for ways to make their loved ones’ daily routines safer. Healthcare and social-care organizations need medication processes that are clear, reliable, and traceable.

items: a service that differentiates it from competitors;
a way to build loyalty among long-term patients;
a practical way to strengthen the pharmacist’s role in the proper use of medicines;
a relationship-building tool for families, caregivers, and partner facilities;
a practical response to the needs created by aging, chronic illness, and polypharmacy.
opportunity.conclusion: PDA is more than a technical development. It changes the pharmacy’s positioning: moving from a model centered on dispensing to one built around service, follow-up, and support.

why.title: Why equip a clinic or hospital?
why.subtitle: Move toward more reliable, faster, and more traceable production
intro: In clinics and hospitals, treatment preparation involves high volumes, multiple prescriptions, frequent changes, and stringent safety requirements.
When preparation relies mainly on manual operations, teams may face several limitations:
limitations: significant time spent sorting and packaging;
risk of confusion between patients, medicines, or administration times;
traceability that may lack sufficient structure;
difficulty standardizing production across multiple operators.
conclusion: Our automated machines address these challenges by automating the key stages of hospital PDA: dispensing, packaging, printing, inspection, sachet organization, and production monitoring.

The objective is not to replace pharmacists or hospital teams. It is to give them industrial tools with which to produce more, improve traceability, and focus their expertise on control, validation, and supervision.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: The MediMesk Story
story.p1_before: MediMesk was born from the vision of
story.p1_after: , a pharmacist by training and a passionate entrepreneur. After years of practicing in community pharmacy, he noticed a growing gap between the technologies available internationally and those accessible to Moroccan pharmacists.
story.p2: Convinced that every pharmacy deserves tools that match its public health mission, he founded MediMesk to become the bridge between world-class manufacturers and the Moroccan market. Since its creation, the company has specialized in distributing innovative solutions — from unit dose dispensing (PDA) with the RDC 45, to professional piercing with Studex, to a growing range of medical equipment.
story.p3: Today, MediMesk is proud to serve a growing network of pharmacies across the Kingdom, with a simple promise: reliable products, human support, and impeccable after-sales service.

items.a: Unit Dose Dispensing (PDA - Préparation des Doses à Administrer) is a high-value professional pharmaceutical service. It involves repackaging oral solid medications into organized devices by day and intake time for a specified period. The goal of PDA systems is to maximize therapeutic adherence and ensure patient safety by eliminating risks associated with handling multiple packages. This service transforms the pharmacy into a proactive health center, optimizing pharmacotherapeutic monitoring and positioning the professional as a key player in the sustainability of the healthcare system.

items.q: How does the RDC 45 Unit Dose Dispensing (PDA) system work?
items.a: The RDC 45 automates the preparation of individual pill organizers by cutting the original blisters. The pharmacist programs the prescriptions via the integrated software, and the machine prepares the doses with complete traceability — reducing dispensing errors by over 99%.

items.q: What types of pharmacies can benefit from MediMesk solutions?
items.a: Our solutions are designed for all pharmacies, regardless of size. Whether you're a neighborhood pharmacy or a large network, we tailor our offerings to your volume and available space. We also serve hospital pharmacies and nursing homes.

items.q: How does the installation and training process work?
items.a: After a diagnostic visit, our technical team installs the equipment on-site, performs commissioning, and trains your entire staff. Training includes software familiarization, first-level maintenance procedures, and dedicated phone support during the first weeks.

items.q: Do you offer after-sales service and maintenance contracts?
items.a: Yes. Each piece of equipment is covered by a manufacturer's warranty. We also offer preventive and corrective maintenance contracts with fast response times throughout Morocco. Our technical support is available by phone and email Monday through Friday.

items.q: How can I request a quote or a demonstration?
items.a: Visit our Contact page or click 'Request a Demo' from any page on the site. Fill in the form with your details and the product you're interested in, and our sales team will get back to you within 24 business hours.

hero.title: Venalink: the best pill organiser to develop unit dose dispensing (PDA)
paragraphs: Venalink manual PDA allows pharmacies to offer a unit dose dispensing service without immediately investing in an automated machine.

With Venalink pill organisers, the pharmacist can organise a patient's treatments by day and intake time, in a clear, practical and personalised format. It is an ideal solution to progressively structure a PDA activity, support chronic or polymedicated patients, help families and enhance the pharmacy's advisory role.
With MediMesk, pharmacies have a complete solution: pill organisers, consumables, accessories, training and service setup support.
A reliable, professional and scalable first step for integrating PDA into your pharmacy. Compatible with scaling up toward semi-automation or full automation.
hero.image_alt: Venalink PDA pill organiser — personalised dosing system

why.title: Why choose manual PDA?
why.subtitle: Start a PDA service without waiting for a machine
paragraphs: Not every pharmacy needs to start with an automated solution. For some pharmacies, the priority is first to test demand, select the first patients, organise the team and build a reliable preparation method.

Venalink manual PDA meets precisely this need: it allows you to launch a professional service with a more progressive investment, while maintaining the safety, readability and personalisation expected by patients.
It is particularly relevant for pharmacies that wish to:
items: Support elderly, chronic or polymedicated patients
Offer a useful service to families and carers
Build patient loyalty over the long term
Test the commercial potential of PDA before automating
conclusion: Manual PDA is not a “less professional” solution. It is often the first structured level of a well-built PDA service.
It allows the pharmacy to move from a box-centred delivery to a clearer logic for the patient: the right medicine, at the right time, in a prepared and identified support.

solution.title: The Venalink Solution
solution.subtitle: Pill organisers designed to organise treatments by intake
paragraphs: The Venalink solution is based on pill organisers consisting of a card and a thermoformed tray. Medicines are prepared in compartments to organise intakes according to the prescribed schedule: day, time, or moment of intake.
This organisation makes the treatment easier to understand for the patient, carer or partner facility.
